unavailable_or_unclassified: Local inherited-model control theorem and reviewed partials, not new native Pro work, hardware, practical quantum computation or historical priority. Known-gain initial theorem and unknown-gain continuations have different contracts. Only first local motion is assumed, not bath norm/bandwidth/higher derivatives. Private averaged-channel guarantees are not recordwise guarantees. Scalar-library floors, fixed-word failures and all-native action-tail lower bounds have different quantifiers; none proves a constant all-native error floor or resolves unknown-gain arbitrary accuracy. Original sign-projection/order-raising and stronger-regularity uniform-gate sources retain credit.
